build_ricker_wavelet: build a discrete Ricker wavelet given resolution, center position, and width parameters
create_ricker_dictionary: create a dictionary matrix of normalized Ricker wavelets with configurable width and component count
run_sparse_coding_omp: run sparse coding on a signal using OMP algorithm with a fixed number of nonzero coefficients
run_sparse_coding_lasso: run sparse coding on a signal using Lasso Lars algorithm with L1 regularization
run_sparse_coding_debiasing: run sparse coding with thresholding and least-squares debiasing on a signal
